note: Attacker-controlled first line of the fuzzer input is '+proj=geos +h=35785831 +sweep=xx', passed as the source projection string to pj_init_plus.
The geos projection string is forwarded to pj_init_plus_ctx for parsing.
The parameter list (including +sweep=xx) is forwarded to pj_init_ctx.
pj_init_ctx dispatches to the projection-specific setup macro, which expands to pj_projection_specific_setup_geos for the geos projection.
Allocates the opaque struct Q and stores it in P->opaque; Q->sweep_axis is initially NULL.
pj_param returns a pointer into the P->params string for the +sweep=xx argument; Q->sweep_axis now aliases memory owned by the params list.
sweep value is 'xx', so Q->sweep_axis[1] is 'x' (not '\0'), making the condition true and entering the error branch.
pj_default_destructor frees P->params (via pj_dealloc_params) and P->opaque, so Q->sweep_axis becomes a dangling pointer into freed memory. The return value is ignored and execution continues.
Reads Q->sweep_axis[0] from the already-freed params buffer, causing a heap-use-after-free READ of size 8 (ASAN crash in pj_projection_specific_setup_geos).
